item.description: Infosys (INFY) said on Saturday, October 10, that it does not expect a material impact from the US Labor Department’s suspension of its green-card applications. In an exchange filing, the company said it welcomes the chance to work with the department and related agencies on their questions.
item.title: Why Infosys Can Shrug Off the US Green-Card Suspension, For Now

item.description: Investing.com -- Infosys (NSE:INFY) said it does not expect a material impact from the U.S. government’s suspension of its participation in the Permanent Labor Certification (PERM) program, a key route for employers to sponsor skilled foreign workers for U.S. permanent residency.
item.title: Infosys sees no material impact from U.S. PERM suspension
